reusableSkillLessons: Share acquisition and immutable custody, never collapse distinct goals: runtime/manifest bundle implementation, direct-dependency advice implementation and module-usage API conformance need different acceptance predicates.

Read historical source before judging outputs: an advisory bundle-issue producer is neither a generated-manifest remediator nor a direct-dependency updater. Preserve predecessor contracts and explicitly name retrospective outcome-informed facets.

Native effects need native parsers, not patch/report counters: the exact three-file AST subtotal is ten even when prose claims hundreds. Preserve module replacements, excluded versions, direct eligibility and source-to-merge path identities.
Complete discovery is not complete native outcome coverage. Keep non-case periods and inaccessible original endpoints unknown while retaining independently established native subtotals.

Do not call a dedicated assertion API migration a verified crash fix when an earlier require.Error already guards the dereference. Structural progress, behavior safeguards, producer receipts and cost remain independent.
handoff: Owned-path-only archive parts plus external per-path size/SHA256 manifest. Do not overwrite global skill, docs, builder or portfolio reports.
